reviewOutcome: Official Sunderland council mapping and ownership pages and HM Land Registry INSPIRE cadastral source were identified. No anonymous ID-plus-geometry parcel response was verified, so no sample GeoJSON was retained. The packet is complete as discovery evidence and held from runtime qualification.

attempts.assessment: Official council page lists planning, brownfield, SHLAA and greenspace interactive maps; no cadastral parcel layer or public parcel API was exposed in the inspected HTML.
Official council guidance says its maps cover council-owned land only and directs private-boundary questions to HM Land Registry; this is a custodian/scope statement, not parcel geometry.
Official Sunderland ArcGIS REST root responded and exposed council map-service folders. Inspected folders were empty or contained base/planning services; no parcel/cadastral service was identified.
Verified public WMS capabilities advertising inspire:CP.CadastralParcel and EPSG:27700/3035/900913/CRS:84. The parcel layer is non-queryable.
Response was an OWS ServiceUnavailable exception stating WFS is disabled; no parcel records returned.
Bounded anonymous probe around the exact WUP point returned LayerNotQueryable/no parcel feature. This is a service limitation and not evidence of citywide absence.

Official download catalogue advertises Sunderland City Council as a GML local-authority file. Anonymous request redirected to the same route under Cloudflare; no file downloaded and no challenge bypass attempted.

Official National Data Library metadata confirms HM Land Registry publisher, Open Government Licence, local-authority splits, and INSPIRE download/WMS links; metadata only, no parcel geometry retained.

cityOrLocalCustodian: HM Land Registry is the evidenced cadastral custodian. Sunderland City Council is evidenced as a local mapping publisher/consumer, but its own ownership guidance limits its maps to council-owned land and no separate public cadastral parcel API was exposed.
